intent.raw: Create an explore strategy and cartographer route to inventory dispersed repository knowledge, then use ontology-vault to condense it without promoting it.
intent.objective: Map dispersed knowledge across domainspec-core into source-backed inventory entries, evidence-cards, EvidenceSets, and a candidate ontology-vault condensation map.
intent.operator_sentence: Really inventory dispersed knowledge first; ontology-vault may condense candidate meaning later, but cannot promote it.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The repository has many dispersed knowledge corpora across public Arcanum, private DomainSpec implementation, project research folders, generated skill mirrors, CyberAlchemy docs, observability, and decision/session surfaces; a single inline scan would either miss corpora or overload the parent context.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Use role-bound cartographers in parallel so each lane owns one source family, returns source-backed receipts, and exposes exclusions before the parent writes inventory entries or ontology candidates.
context: Inventory package exists at .arcanum/inventory/ and currently has only a high-level source-system map.
The user requested the frontmatter tagging profile used by research/cyber-alchemy-space/capability-taxonomy/findings.md.
Ontology-vault must remain a candidate condensation layer; it must not promote Inventory, Ontology, glossary, sigil, or spell knowledge.
Public/private boundaries apply: arcanum/ is public, while this parent and implementation/domainspec are private.

roles.purpose: Map public Arcanum framework, registry, sigils, spells, and generated runtime mirrors.
roles.owns: source-backed receipt for arcanum/, .agents/skills/, .claude/skills/, .codex/commands/, and .github/skills without copying private material into public surfaces.

roles.purpose: Map private DomainSpec implementation, submodule discipline, v1 evidence, and validation harness knowledge.
roles.owns: source-backed receipt for implementation/domainspec/, validation/poker-team/, docs/, ops/, sessions/, and telemetry boundaries.

roles.purpose: Map project and research towers, especially domainspec-v2, framework-unification, ontologize, CyberAlchemy, and cyber-alchemy-space research.
roles.owns: source-backed receipt for projects/, research/, cyberAlchemy/, and tower conventions.

roles.purpose: Map inventory, ontology, definitions, Craft, Necronomicon, observability, dispatch, and promotion-governance surfaces.
roles.owns: source-backed receipt for .arcanum/, .craft where present, ontology/vault folders, dispatch ledgers, and governance documents.

roles.purpose: Attack the parent synthesis for missed corpora, duplicate authority, source-less claims, and ontology promotion leakage.
roles.owns: defect receipt against the inventory synthesis and ontology-vault condensation map.

subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: Run the required repository cartographer subagents for 2026-06-18-dispersed-knowledge-cartography and require source-backed receipts before inventory ingest?

steps.name: Create source manifest and tagging profile
stop_conditions: block if source cohorts lack concrete paths
block if generated inventory metadata claims canonical promotion authority

steps.name: Run source-family cartographers
stop_conditions: block if any spawned cartographer remains unjoined or unclosed
flag any corpus excluded because of size, privacy, binary format, or submodule dirt

steps.name: Create inventory entries, cards, sets, and lookup pages
stop_conditions: block if findings cite generated synthesis without raw cartographer or source evidence
flag contradictions instead of overwriting source claims

steps.name: Condense candidate meaning with ontology-vault
stop_conditions: block if ontology-vault asserts bridge alignment without evidence from both business and system branches
block if candidate ontology output claims promotion

steps.name: Validate route, inventory, and ontology boundary guardrails
stop_conditions: block if dispatch-spec validation returns block
flag missing evidence-cards, missing EvidenceSets, untagged generated pages, or ontology promotion ambiguity

steps.name: Prepare next-route handoff
stop_conditions: ask for explicit operator permission before spawning any cartographer agents

gates.condition: Subagent cartography cannot run until the operator explicitly confirms the dispatch.
Raw repository sources remain read-only; generated inventory artifacts must cite them.
Private parent or implementation evidence must not be written into public arcanum/ artifacts.
Execution evidence must not promote Inventory, Ontology, glossary, sigil, or spell knowledge without owner review.
Ontology bridge claims require evidence from both branch sides or must remain explicit gaps.
Route validates with dispatch-spec and records pass, flag, or block state.

boundaries.contract: The route may require cartographers, but runtime subagent execution waits for explicit operator permission.
Ontology-vault consumes inventory cards and findings as evidence records, not as promoted ontology authority.
Generated private inventory and ontology-vault artifacts may cite private paths; public arcanum/ artifacts must not be mutated by this route.

authority.lifecycle: dispatch-spec route artifact until operator confirms runtime
authority.execution: operator-approved parent session or domainspec-subagents-strategy after confirmation
authority.validation: dispatch-spec plus inventory lint and ontology-vault validate
authority.promotion: downstream owner only; no direct promotion from this route

state_namespaces.write_policy: read-only for inventory ingest; no raw source mutation
generated pages, entries, cards, sets, queries, lint, index, tags, and log under .arcanum/inventory/
candidate maps under .arcanum/ontology-vault/; no convention mutation without explicit approval
append-only signals and run notes when not ignored by repository policy

promotion_splits.rule: requires inventory owner review before any candidate becomes durable lookup output
ontology-vault may condense branch roles and gaps, but cannot promote governed ontology without separate review

promotion_splits.target: Definitions, glossary, sigil, spell, or canonical ontology
promotion_splits.rule: requires downstream owner decision and separate promotion artifact

promotion_guardrails: Route execution evidence is not canonical promotion.
Inventory owns evidence-cards and candidate EvidenceSets only.
Ontology-vault owns candidate branch maps and confidence review; promotion requires a later owner decision.
Public arcanum/ is not a target for private inventory writes.
